doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Losing musicians like Moody and Clark Terry

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You mention people that you don’t know anymore, and it kind of gets – you didn’t use the word, but depressing in some way. Does that apply at all to the music field and the people who are no longer with us?
It’s tragic. It’s sad. It is. I know we’re going to lose some people soon.

You read my mind. And that’s going to break my heart. He was so – he is just such a sweetheart, and to realize how ill he is. But he would never let on that he was ill. Clark Terry. There’s some of the guys that are – I’m going to be missing them, and I’m not really prepared yet to deal with it.
